v-html can lead to XSS attacks. Details: Avoid using it with user-provided content Help: Security Risk: v-html renders raw HTML and can execute malicious scripts from user input. Alternatives: 1. Use text interpolation (auto-escaped):

2. Use a sanitization library: import DOMPurify from 'dompurify' const safeHtml = DOMPurify.sanitize(userInput) 3. Use a markdown renderer with XSS protection If you must use v-html: - Never use with user-provided content - Only use with trusted, static content
